prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: four DRAWN pixel-cluster fog-bank edge fade masks. Draw a tall stack of FOUR SEPARATE wide horizontal rectangular strips on a square solid #ff00ff magenta canvas, with narrow pure magenta gutters between strips. Every strip has exact straight full-width TOP edge; bottom is a ragged open feathered transition into magenta. Each strip width:height about 4:1. The image will be converted to a discrete-alpha mask for fog, so use ONLY flat shades #ffffff, #cccccc, #999999, #666666, #333333 and pure #ff00ff. Inside each strip: the uppermost 1/6 of height is solid white from left to right, with no holes; below it white thins into large irregular interlocking step-edged light grey clusters, then medium grey, dark grey, very dark grey, then completely magenta at the bottom. Most of the bottom eighth is clear magenta. Boundaries between the flat grey levels are varied drawn shallow ragged filaments, with little connected fingers and openings, never straight horizontal bands. Avoid repeated bumps, rounded contours, disconnected dots, speckles, dithering, airbrush, smooth gradient and noise. Each of the four strips needs a different irregular contour, natural layered wisps rather than a sawtooth rhythm. All pixels square, draw large crisp pixel art with block steps suitable for reducing each strip to 192x48. The TOP white plateau must reach exactly both side boundaries. No text, numbers, borders, shadows, landscape or objects.

Use case: stylized-concept. Draw a fog-edge mask atlas: FOUR DIFFERENT very wide horizontal strips stacked in four equally tall rows on a square canvas. Pure solid #ff00ff magenta background and gutters. Each strip approximately 4:1 width to height. The upper boundary is a dead straight full-width horizontal edge with a white band covering its top 15 percent. From that white inner plateau downwards, paint several broad interlocking shredded horizontal mist layers: white #ffffff, light grey #cccccc, mid grey #999999, dark grey #666666, charcoal #333333, then ragged fully magenta gaps near the bottom. FLAT colours ONLY, no blend, no gradient. These are source masks to be palette-reduced and used as discrete opacity caps; they are not visible dark fog. The light-to-dark layer boundaries must have shallow long irregular pixel fingers, a few channels, and uneven heights. Keep the outermost tips sparse and thin, ending in magenta with a clear magenta margin. No regular scallops, no drips, no cloud lobes, no noisy specks. Large deliberate crisp square pixel clusters. Each of the four strips has a unique quiet natural irregular outline and internal layer structure, while the top white plateau has no gaps all the way left to right. Draw at large size to reduce to 192x48 per strip. No labels, objects, terrain, outline frame or smooth curves.
